# streamtime_member (Resource)

A person who belongs to the organization, with the role they hold. Create invites the person; their identity must also exist at the organization's sign-in provider. For built-in sign-in, supply an initial password for a new person.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "streamtime_member" "ana" {
  email = "ana@example.com"
  role  = "Administrator"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The member's email address. It is also the ID you use to import them. Changing it adds a different member.

### Optional

- `initial_password` (String, Sensitive) Initial password for a new person using built-in sign-in. It is sent only when inviting the person, never changes an existing password, and is retained in sensitive Terraform state.
- `role` (String) The role the member holds, for example Administrator. Leave it out to leave the member's role unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the member. Use it to import an existing one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the member's email address.
terraform import streamtime_member.ana ana@example.com
```
